svg.title: What charter provides (charter 0.4.19)
svg.desc: Seven capabilities: one outside any project (install and oversee) and six inside a project: keep the owner in charge, write down what is agreed, work in units, check every change, run the road unattended, say what is true and what it cost.

g.title: Install, upgrade and oversee projects. One checkout of this repository installs the package into any project, keeps it current and watches the fleet.
g.text: The machine layer, once per user:
a SessionStart hook says when a
each owned file hashed; CI refuses

g.title: Owner: The one person who signs, rules and merges, and holds the files that define the gates
Agent session: Claude Code, Codex or pi; works one unit at a time and proposes what it cannot settle
Keep the owner in charge. The files and fields that define the gates are the owner's. Agents propose; the owner rules in one command.
g.text: The files and fields that define the gates are the
owner's. Agents propose; the owner rules in one command.

g.title: Owner: The one person who signs, rules and merges, and holds the files that define the gates
Owner's delegate: A watcher run by cron outside Claude Code; takes the owner acts that the owner's level allows
Agent session: Claude Code, Codex or pi; works one unit at a time and proposes what it cannot settle
Write down what is agreed. What is sold, the road and every design choice live in the repository, one file each, where a machine can check them.

g.aria-label: Work in units that prove themselves
g.title: Work in units that prove themselves. Each deliverable is one file that says what it may touch, how it will be checked, and what happened.
g.text: Each deliverable is one file that
says what it may touch, how it will

g.title: Agent session: Claude Code, Codex or pi; works one unit at a time and proposes what it cannot settle
Check every change, three times. One engine judges each change as the agent edits, at commit, and in CI from a clean clone.
g.text: One engine judges each change as the
agent edits, at commit, and in CI

g.title: The gates: Claude Code hooks, the git hook and CI, all running one engine
Agent session: Claude Code, Codex or pi; works one unit at a time and proposes what it cannot settle
Run the road unattended. A chain of fresh sessions works the road unit after unit, each checking the last, reviewed group by group.
Agent session: Claude Code, Codex or pi; works one unit at a time and proposes what it cannot settle
Independent reviewer: A party that wrote neither side, meant to be another model family (Codex) or a person
Owner: The one person who signs, rules and merges, and holds the files that define the gates

g.aria-label: Say what is true, and what it cost
g.title: Say what is true, and what it cost. Progress, acceptance and cost are computed from the repository, and every claim points at something a reader can open.
Agent session: Claude Code, Codex or pi; works one unit at a time and proposes what it cannot settle
Owner: The one person who signs, rules and merges, and holds the files that define the gates
Client: Signs the devis that the scope summarises; reads the accepted units
